subject: general
question: What will happen if the ozone layer becomes thinner?

options.text: Amount of surface ozone will increase
The ozone hole will close by redistribution
Cases of skin cancer will increase

solution:
The correct answer is __**Cases of skin cancer will increase**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If the ozone layer becomes thinner, cases of skin cancer will increase: 
 
• Increased UV radiation
 
• Ozone absorbs ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the sun, so a thinner ozone layer allows more UV radiation to reach the Earth's surface.
 
• Increased skin cancer
 
• More UV radiation increases the risk of skin cancer, eye cataracts, and damage to the immune system.
 
• Other damage
 
• UV radiation can also damage plants, crops, and ocean plankton.
 
• Increased UV Index
 
• Decreases in ozone lead to increases in the UV Index.
 
• Ozone depletion is a major environmental problem. It's most pronounced in the polar regions, especially over Antarctica.
 
• Some human-produced chemicals, such as nitrous oxide, can release chlorine and bromine, which deplete the ozone layer when exposed to high ultraviolet light.
